business_summary: New World Department Store China Limited, an investment holding company, owns and operates department stores and shopping malls in the People's Republic of China. The company operates its department stores, supermarkets, and shopping malls under the New World and Ba Li Chun Tian brand names, as well as concept shops under Love  Original  Life (LOL) brand names. It also offers investment activities; and provision of management and financing services. New World Department Store China Limited was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong. New World Department Store China Limited operates as a subsidiary of New World Development Company Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자지주회사인 New World Department Store China Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 백화점과 쇼핑몰을 소유 및 운영하고 있습니다. New World, Ba Li Chun Tian 브랜드로 백화점, 슈퍼마켓, 쇼핑몰을 운영하고 있으며, Love Original Life(LOL) 브랜드로 컨셉숍을 운영하고 있습니다. 또한 투자 활동도 제공합니다. 관리 및 금융 서비스 제공. New World Department Store China Limited는 1993년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 청사완에 본사를 두고 있습니다. New World Department Store China Limited는 New World Development Company Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
